City Council Meeting
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA City Council Meeting
March 14, 2017 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Karen Bufkin for her years of service and present her with a service award pin and a Certificate of Recognition.
Item 6.1 Recognition of City Employee for Years of Service
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
REAPPOINTMENT TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council reappoint Lesley Watkins to the La Mirada Community Foundation for a term expiring in May 2017.
Item 7.1 Reappointment to La Mirada Community Foundation
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of February 28, 2017.
Item 8.1 Minutes of 2/28/17 CC Mtg.
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated March 14, 2017 in the total amount of $1,746,569.43.
Item 8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING FEBRUARY 2017 â€“ It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Cityâ€™s Investment Report for the month ending February 2017.
Item 8.3 Investment Report
8.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2014-24, ALONDRA BOULEVARD AT LA MIRADA BOULEVARD INTERSECTION IMPROVEMENT PLANS - REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2014-24, Alondra Boulevard at La Mirada Boulevard Intersection Improvement Plans, to Elecnor Belco Electric, Inc. in the amount of $169,306; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction survey, inspection and testing services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost including construction, and construction testing and inspection.
Item 8.4 CIP No. 2014-24 - Award of Contract
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2015-14, LA MIRADA BOULEVARD CORRIDOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL UPGRADES â€“ APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301, Class 1 (c) and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for CIP No. 2015-14, La Mirada Boulevard Corridor Traffic Signal Upgrades; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
Item 8.5 CIP No. 2015-14 Approval of Plans and Specifications
8.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-01, CREEK PARK MASTER PLAN â€“ APPROVAL OF PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT - It is recommended the City Council accept the proposal dated January 12, 2017 from RRM Design Group for CIP No. 2017-01, Creek Park Master Plan, for professional services in an amount not to exceed $308,380; authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with RRM Design Group for professional services on behalf of the City; and authorize the City Manager to approve RRM Design Group additional professional services up to 20 percent of the authorized contract award amount, if required.
Item 8.6 CIP No. 2017-01- Approval of Agreement
8.7
AMENDMENT NO. 3 TO THE AGREEMENT DATED APRIL 14, 2011 BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA AND CHANDLER ASSET MANAGEMENT, INC. - It is recommended the City Council approve Amendment No. 3 to the Agreement dated April 14, 2011 between the City of La Mirada and Chandler Asset Management, Inc., and authorize the City Manager to execute the document on behalf of the City.
Item 8.7 Amendment to Agreement - Chandler Asset Mgmt.
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 17-05 APPROVING THE ISSUANCE OF REVENUE BONDS BY THE CALIFORNIA MUNICIPAL FINANCE AUTHORITY FOR BIOLA UNIVERSITY - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as required by law and adopt Resolution No. 17-05 approving the issuance of $90,000,000 in revenue bonds by the California Municipal Finance Authority to refinance the cost of certain improvements to Biola University.
Item 9.1 Resolution No. 17-05
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 17-06 AUTHORIZING A BUDGET AMENDMENT TO ALLOCATE ADDITIONAL COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) FUNDS AND CALIFORNIA HIGH-SPEED RAIL AUTHORITY (HSRA) FUNDS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-06 authorizing a budget amendment to allocate additional Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) funds and California High-Speed Rail Authority (HSRA) funds.
Item 10.1 Resolution No. 17-06
10.2
RESOLUTION NO. 17-07 ELECTING TO BECOME SUBJECT TO THE UNIFORM PUBLIC CONSTRUCTION COST ACCOUNTING ACT AND ORDINANCE NO. 692 REVISING PURCHASING PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC PROJECTS, ADOPTING EMERGENCY PROCUREMENT PROCEDURES AND AMENDING TITLE 3 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-07 electing to become subject to the Uniform Public Construction Cost Account Act and introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 692 revising purchasing procedures for public projects, adopting emergency procurement procedures, and amending Title 3 of the La Mirada Municipal Code.
Item 10.2 Resolution No. 17-07 & Ord. 692
10.3
RESOLUTION NO. 17-08 APPROVING ASSOCIATE MEMBERSHIP BY THE CITY IN THE CALIFORNIA ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY; AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING THE EXECUTION OF AN ASSOCIATE MEMBERSHIP AGREEMENT RELATING TO ASSOCIATE MEMBERSHIP OF THE CITY IN THE AUTHORITY; AUTHORIZING THE CITY TO JOIN THE FIGTREE PACE PROGRAM; AUTHORIZING THE CALIFORNIA ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY TO CONDUCT CONTRACTUAL ASSESSMENT PROCEEDINGS AND LEVY CONTRACTUAL ASSESSMENTS WITHIN THE TERRITORY OF THE CITY OF LA MIRADA; AND AUTHORIZING RELATED ACTIONS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-08 and execute an agreement allowing the inclusion of properties within La Mirada's jurisdiction to participate in the Figtree PACE financing program.
Item 10.3 Resolution No. 17-08
10.4
RESOLUTION NO. 17-09 APPROVING, AUTHORIZING, AND DIRECTING EXECUTION OF A JOINT EXERCISE OF POWERS AGREEMENT RELATING TO THE CALIFORNIA MUNICIPAL FINANCE AUTHORITY; CONSENTING TO THE INCLUSION OF PROPERTIES WITHIN THE TERRITORY OF THE CITY IN THE CALIFORNIA MUNICIPAL FINANCE AUTHORITY OPEN PACE PROGRAMS; AUTHORIZING THE CALIFORNIA MUNICIPAL FINANCE AUTHORITY TO ACCEPT APPLICATIONS FROM PROPERTY OWNERS, CONDUCT CONTRACTUAL ASSESSMENT PROCEEDINGS AND LEVY CONTRACTUAL ASSESSMENTS WITHIN THE TERRITORY OF THE CITY; AND AUTHORIZING RELATED ACTIONS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-09 and execute an agreement allowing the inclusion of properties within La Mirada's jurisdiction to participate in the California Municipal Finance Authority PACE program.
Item 10.4 Resolution No. 17-09
10.5
RESOLUTION NO. 17-10 CONSENTING TO INCLUSION OF PROPERTIES WITHIN THE CITY'S JURISDICTION IN THE CALIFORNIA HOME FINANCE AUTHORITY COMMUNITY FACILITIES DISTRICT NO. 2014-1 (CLEAN ENERGY) TO FINANCE RENEWABLE ENERGY IMPROVEMENTS, ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND WATER CONSERVATION IMPROVEMENTS AND ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING INFRASTRUCTURE AND APPROVING ASSOCIATE MEMBERSHIP IN THE JOINT EXERCISE OF POWERS AUTHORITY RELATED THERETO AND RESOLUTION NO. 17-11 CONSENTING TO INCLUSION OF PROPERTIES WITHIN THE CITY'S JURISDICTION IN THE CALIFORNIA HOME FINANCE AUTHORITY, PROGRAM TO FINANCE RENEWABLE ENERGY GENERATION, ENERGY AND WATER EFFICIENCY IMPROVEMENTS AND ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING INFRASTRUCTURE AND APPROVING ASSOCIATE MEMBERSHIP IN THE JOINT EXERCISE OF POWERS AUTHORITY RELATED THERETO - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-10 and Resolution No. 17-11 and execute an agreement allowing the inclusion of properties within La Mirada's jurisdiction to participate in the Ygrene PACE Financing Program.
Item 10.5 Resolution Nos. 17-10 and 17-11
